title: Kenyan Peanut Tagine Schnitzel
description: A German twist on the traditional Kenyan peanut tagine dish, featuring flaky schnitzel and served with a side of peanuts.
instructions: Season the cutlets with salt and pepper.
In a shallow dish, mix together the peanut tagine spice mix, flour, and a pinch of salt.
In a separate dish, mix together the buttermilk and a pinch of salt.
Dip each cutlet into the buttermilk mixture, coating both sides, then into the flour mixture, coating both sides.
Dip the floured cutlet into the beaten eggs, coating both sides.
Then coat the egg-coated cutlet in Panko breadcrumbs, pressing gently to adhere.
Heat about 1/4 inch of vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2-3 breaded cutlets to the skillet and fry until golden brown and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Transfer the fried cutlets to a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
Serve the schnitzel hot with a side of chopped peanuts.
